metric_rationale: This metric calculates the proportion of trials where the participant's choice aligns with the strict prediction of the Tallying heuristic, computed only on trials where Tallying has a strict preference (i.e., one option has more winning features than the other). The experimental design includes multiple trials where Tallying and WADD make diametrically opposed predictions (e.g., Tallying favors the option with many weak features, while WADD favors the option with fewer strong features). Consequently, data generated by the Tallying model will yield a high score on this metric, whereas data generated by the WADD model will yield a score significantly below 0.5.

Focuses exclusively on Trial 1, the most discriminative trial type in the design. On this trial, one option has 2 high-validity features (favored by WADD) while the other has 3 low-validity features (favored by Tallying). The metric computes the proportion of choices for the Tallying-favored option. Tallying will yield a high value (close to 1), while WADD will yield a low value (close to 0).
